pages.text: While projected, currents, bubble columns and lava contact do not affect you. Submersion does not drown you and lava does not ignite you. Fire from other sources still hurts. Normal fluid interaction resumes upon return.
Ice and Fire integration, helmets only. Press the Tinkers helmet interaction key to project; press again to return. Lasts 30 seconds per level, up to 90 seconds.

Fly through blocks other than bedrock. Interact, fight, mine and build with your own inventory and permissions. Physical melee and physical projectile damage are ignored by the spirit; magic, elemental and other damage types still apply directly without armor or toughness. A hit on the anchored body ends projection immediately. Manual or automatic return starts a cooldown: 85/70/55 seconds for levels I/II/III.

Level I costs two ability slots: one pixie wing item, one ghost ingot and one ectoplasm. Level II: two ingots and three ectoplasm. Level III: three ingots, one ectoplasm and one pixie dust. Levels II and III cost no additional slots.
